title: Simple low-risk task uses a lightweight route
prompt: In a local documentation file, correct one obvious spelling mistake without changing meaning or other content.
expected_behaviors: Classifies the task as simple and low risk with a clear rationale.
Uses a lightweight route rather than forcing the full multi-phase workflow.
Keeps the change limited to the requested typo and performs a proportionate verification.
must_not: Must not modify unrelated files or expand the documentation scope.
Must not create unnecessary persistent workflow artifacts.
